This use case shows how you can shift from reactive SoD checks to continuous, real-time oversight, so your team is always one step ahead of exposures. Learn More The SoD challenge When the same employee handles more than one step in any process, the risk of error and even fraud is significantly higher. That’s why maintaining compliance with segregation of duties (SoD) is crucial. But tracking SoD with traditional compliance monitoring software can be very difficult. Overlapping responsibilities The costs of mistakes can be significant. For example, creating multiple records for the same entity will result in costly duplicate payments. Transaction overload Continuously monitoring thousands of transactions across numerous locations is impossible. Evolving privileges User access rights frequently change, hindering the ability to monitor and enforce employees’ adherence to SoD. Why the traditional approach won’t do The traditional approach to SoD management is based on pre-defined rules, manual checks, and post-incident detection, which can’t adapt to the dynamic nature of today’s quickly evolving organizations. Pre-defined rules miss hidden violations, especially as roles overlap and people move to new positions. Manual checks are time consuming, reducing accuracy and making scalability unachievable. A reactive approach means identifying issues only after they’ve occurred, delaying detection and response. Prevent SoD violations before the damage is done The Datricks Financial Integrity Platform goes far beyond compliance monitoring software by bringings the three core capabilities needed for autonomous, real-time, continuous, and preventive control over SoD. 1 Autonomous process discovery Without needing any input, Datricks automatically and continuously analyzes your financial processes in order to understand your business context. 2 Integrity exposure detection Problems are identified across all business data and analyzed by our AI in the context of their financial processes in real time. 3 Integrity intelligence CFOs get a comprehensive control tower to understand the overall health of their organizations.
